methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: AI Ready Roanoke evaluates use for new technology in Roanoke Valley - Roanoke Times
signals.signal_reading: A community-led initiative to evaluate AI readiness in the Roanoke Valley signals distributed capacity-building beyond traditional tech hubs, potentially creating peer learning networks that spread deep AI literacy across a non-metro region.

signals.title: News Flash Archive - NPD E911 Division implements Artificial Intelligence (AI) system on non-emergency lines - City of Norfolk (.gov)
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk's deployment of turnkey AI for non-emergency call routing represents shallow but functional adoption—platform-delivered capability that improves services without requiring deep technical expertise, signaling distributed breadth over depth.

signals.title: Amazon bows to local backlash over AI data centers, scraps plans to build four new facilities in Northern Virginia — site to be repurposed for mixed-use and residential development. - Tom's Hardware
signals.signal_reading: Amazon's cancellation of four NoVA data centers due to local backlash reveals infrastructure resistance even in the state's AI epicenter, potentially slowing both the concentration of deep capability and its distributed benefits to other regions.

signals.title: Virginia governor orders statewide plan to address AI cyberattacks - StateScoop
signals.signal_reading: A gubernatorial directive for statewide AI cybersecurity planning could either concentrate defensive expertise in Richmond/NoVA policy centers or distribute readiness across regions—the execution determines whether this deepens existing pockets or builds new ones.

signals.title: Clearview Dynamics LLC eyes Roanoke County for potential data center at Wood Haven Technology Park - WSLS
signals.signal_reading: A potential data center in Roanoke County creates infrastructure that could anchor deep AI capability outside NoVA, but without intentional workforce development, risks becoming extractive infrastructure that concentrates economic benefits elsewhere while distributing only energy costs.
